test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper publishes a list of prices which are 60% above the CP. He proposes to give 20% discount. How much profit does he really make?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (M.P) = 160% × Cost price (C.P)

Discount% = 20%

**Formula used:**

If discount = D% then,

Selling price (S.P) = M.P × (100 - D)%

Profit = S.P - C.P

Profit% = (P × 100)/C.P

**Calculation:**

Marked price (M.P) = 160% × Cost price (C.P)

M.P/C.P = 160/100

M.P = 160 and C.P = 100

Selling price (S.P) = 160 × (100 - 20)%

⇒ 160 × 80% = Rs.128

Profit% = {(128 - 100) × 100}/100

⇒ 28%

**∴ The correct answer is 28%. **
